scope: Spanish/English localization of the F22A6 dashboard and 102-component atlas
method: Visible in-app-browser interactions plus DOM-only observations; CPU translation completeness and persistence tests.

checks.evidence: Spanish → English → Spanish retained selected Pistons details and paused crank angle 355 degrees.
pistón found Pistons, rings, pins and connecting rods after accent normalization; both languages searched.
Translated view labels, settings, evidence, flow and cycle controls. Selector usable at 240 percent text; no document horizontal overflow at 1456px. Restored 140 percent.
IAB butterfly, IAB filter with nine results, Motion tab, 50 percent mechanism progress and 15 degree inspection angle persisted.
Changing atlas language updated the already-open main dashboard; reload and navigation retained language.
Followed atlas back-engine link, changed main language, returned with browser Back. Atlas title and selector agreed; rotation and switching still worked.
English and Spanish header and controls inspected in large-text mode; restored previous standard size.
Read-aloud starts; switching language cancels old utterance and restores Listen. Selected-language voice logic reviewed; actual voice pronunciation not audibly assessed.
IAB MP4 switched EN → ES while playing; paused ES → EN preserved exact 5.377363-second position. Correct /en/ MP4, English burned-in text, and srclang=en VTT observed.

evidenceLimits: Localization preserves the existing technical evidence and approximation notices. It does not establish new measured engine specifications.
